scope: Independent read-only review of case-analysis.mjs, reconstruction-diagram.mjs and scenes.mjs, with targeted app.mjs override persistence inspection; nine deterministic cases manually compared against complete Narrative and nonempty raw values. This is sampled content and code-level QA, not exhaustive 134-case review or final pixel/render QA.

sampleChecks.followUp: Retained legacy custom sequence should use reviewed intersection setting; root reported a setting-aware background update, final assembled integration not tested here.

checks: Read full Narrative: first parking sub-lot curb, stop at main exit, second curb on road entry, rightward drift and sidewall rub, driver intervention, later manual-drive right-rear tire failure and low-pressure indicator.
